subject: general
question: The Rihand Hydroelectric Project is located in which district of Uttar Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonebhadra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rihand Hydroelectric Project:** The Rihand Dam, also known as the Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar, is located in the district of **Sonebhadra** in the state of **Uttar Pradesh**. It is one of the most significant hydroelectric projects in the region.
 
• **Location:** The dam is built across the **Rihand River**, which is a tributary of the Son River. This region is known for its significant contributions to energy production in India.
 
• **Hydroelectric Power Generation:** The Rihand Hydroelectric Project plays a vital role in generating electricity and providing power to nearby regions. The project has helped meet the increasing energy demands of Uttar Pradesh and its neighboring states.
 
• **Reservoir:** The dam creates a reservoir known as **Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar**, which is the largest artificial lake in India. It is an essential water source for irrigation and supports the livelihoods of farmers in the area.
 
• **Economic Importance:** The region around the Rihand Dam is rich in natural resources, including coal, which has led to the establishment of several power plants and industries in **Sonebhadra**.
 
• **Tourism Potential:** The Rihand Dam and its surrounding areas have become a popular destination for tourists due to their scenic beauty and the vast expanse of the reservoir.
 
• **Environment:** While the dam has brought significant benefits, it has also impacted the environment, including the displacement of people during its construction and changes to the local ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sonebhadra District:**

 
 
• **Location:** Sonebhadra is situated in the southeastern part of **Uttar Pradesh**. It shares borders with Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Bihar.
 
• **Natural Resources:** Sonebhadra is rich in resources like **coal, limestone, and bauxite**. It is referred to as the "Energy Capital of India" due to its numerous power plants.
 
• **Power Plants:** The district houses several thermal and hydroelectric power plants, which contribute significantly to India's energy production.
 
 
 
• **Rihand River:**
 
 
• **Tributary:** The Rihand River is a tributary of the **Son River**, which further joins the **Ganga River**. It originates in Madhya Pradesh and flows through Uttar Pradesh.
 
• **Significance:** The river supports irrigation, drinking water supply, and industrial activities in the region.
 
 
 
• **Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar:**
 
 
• **Largest Reservoir:** It is the largest artificial lake in **India**, with a catchment area of about 37,583 square kilometers.
 
• **Uses:** The reservoir is used for irrigation, drinking water, fisheries, and recreational activities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Historical Context:**

 
 
• **Construction:** The Rihand Dam was constructed in the late **1950s** and was inaugurated in **1962**.
 
• **Purpose:** The primary objective of the dam was to provide irrigation facilities and generate hydroelectric power for the region.
 
 
 
• **Challenges:**
 
 
• **Environmental Impact:** The construction of the dam led to the submergence of villages, displacement of people, and changes to the local flora and fauna.
 
• **Rehabilitation:** Efforts were made to rehabilitate the displaced communities, but challenges remain in ensuring their livelihoods and social integration.
